workaround_steps: Use a Magisk root build with DenyList configured to hide root from the Netflix app.
Expect reduced maximum playback resolution; HD (1080p) streams are gated by Widevine L1, which WSA does not provide.
If playback fails after app updates, clear the app data and re-authenticate.
known_issues: Widevine L1 is unavailable under WSA, so playback is capped below HD and some titles refuse to stream entirely.
